newsitem.title: BELARUS: SOCCER-BELARUS NAME NEW STRIKE FORCE FOR SCOTLAND GAME.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-BELARUS NAME NEW STRIKE FORCE FOR SCOTLAND GAME.

text.p: Belarus will have a new-look forward line for their World Cup qualifier against Scotland next week, with a pair of strikers from newly-crowned cup winners Belshyna getting their break in the national team.

Anchored to the bottom of European group four after last month's 2-0 defeat in Latvia, and with just three goals from five games, Belarus officials said on Friday that Belshyna's Andrei Khlebosolov and Dmitry Balashov had been called up for the June 8 fixture in Minsk against group leaders Scotland.

Belshyna from provincial Bobruisk won the Belarussian Cup last weekend and are also leading the local league. As before, however, the backbone of the squad is made up of exiles playing in Russia. Six of the 19-man squad play for Dynamo Moscow.
Goalkeepers - Andrei Satsunkevich (Lokomotiv Nizhny Novgorod, Russia), Valery Shantalosov (Baltika Kaliningrad, Russia)

Defenders - Sergei Gurenko (Lokomotiv Moscow), Sergei Shtanyuk, Erik Yakhimovich, Andrei Lavrik (all Dynamo Moscow), Valentin Belkevich (Dynamo Kiev, Ukraine), Vyacheslav Gerashchenko (Chernomorets Novorossiisk, Russia)
Midfielders - Alexander Kulchy, Andrei Ostrovsky, Andrei Dovnar (all Dynamo Moscow), Rodislav Orlovsky (Torpedo Moscow), Sergei Gerasimets (Baltika Kaliningrad), Igor Tarlovsky (Dynamo-93 Minsk)
Forwards - Vladimir Makovsky (Dynamo Minsk), Miroslav Romashchenko (Spartak Moscow), Viktor Bezmen (Lokomotiv-96 Vitebsk, Belarus), Andrei Khlebosolov, Dmitry Balashov (both Belshyna Bobruisk).
